newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Optics says no fundamental change.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Optics says no fundamental change.

text.p: Advanced Optics Electronics, an outdoor electronic billboard maker, said Thursday, the recent volatility in its stock is not due to any fundamental changes made by the company.
Leslie Robbins, the company's chief executive officer, said in a statement, "The recent volatility in our share price does not reflect any fundamental changes in the company."
The company said that in the last seven days, its stock has reached a high of $1.62, up from a low of $0.31.
Robbins added, "We are pleased to see increased investor awareness of the viability of flat panel technologies within the outdoor advertising industry."
In mid-day trading on the OTC Bulletin Board, the stock was down 1/16 at 3/4.
